In perl-current(5.9.5) maybe there is not a test case to test "_PATH_LOG".
I copied a test case from perl-5.8.7 which came from an IBM customer on 
z/OS:

#!/usr/lpp/perl/bin/perl -w

use Sys::Syslog qw( :DEFAULT setlogsock);
use strict;

setlogsock('unix');
openlog($0, 'pid,cons', 'LOG_USER');
syslog('info', "test message from $0");
closelog();

If the ext/Sys/Syslog/Makefile.Pl has these codes like:
  if (-S "/dev/log" && -w "/dev/log") {

I got these return when I run the test case above on z/OS:
unix passed to setlogsock, but path not available at sys.t line 6
.

If changed those code in Makefile.PL to:
  if ((-S "/dev/log" || -c "/dev/log") && -w "/dev/log") {
I got:
no connection to syslog available
        - /dev/log is not a socket at sys.t line 8
.

Recently, I am very busy. I have no time to investigate the 2nd error.
If you know the reason, please let me know. Thanks a lot.



Ge, Chun Bing
